comments: Normfluss evaluates PDF documents against PDF/UA-1 and WCAG, provides a free check with a detailed report, and offers optional remediation with a signed evidence record. EU-resident processing.
features: Normfluss checks PDF documents against PDF/UA-1 and the PDF-applicable parts of WCAG 2.1/2.2, reporting exactly which machine-checkable criteria pass or fail. It identifies issues like missing structure, undescribed images and links, and metadata problems, and issues a signed evidence record of what was tested. Free check; optional remediation.
title: Normfluss
